findings.title: Hardcoded credential in settings loader
findings.description: The settings loader reads a credential that never rotates across releases.
findings.remediation: Move the credential to the secret store and read it at startup.

findings.title: Repository appears unmaintained: no commits in two years
findings.description: The repository shows no maintenance activity across the last two years.
findings.remediation: Confirm ownership and archive or transfer the repository.

scanner_correlation.notes: Synthetic value used only by a test.

remediation_roadmap.action: Rotate the credential and move it to the secret store.
